content.rationale: Users need an open-source, customizable environment to manage agent skills and automation workflows locally, with safety guardrails against script corruption and accessible UI controls.
content.semantic_summary: feat: skills management hub, bundled starter skills, and python automation studio: Added Workspace Specials Skills & Automations Hub to manage, edit, and run agent skills and exposed Python automations. Bundled open-source starter skills in skills/ and core scripts in server/scripts/. Implemented safe in-browser script editing with .bak backups and syntax compilation checking. Revamped visual text hierarchy with semantic tokens and WCAG 2.1 AA compliance, and fixed modal accessibility.
